questions.text:
Name a geographic environment AND a cultural process to use to answer both parts of the question.

Use the space provided to draw an annotated map(s) and/or diagram(s) to explain how your chosen cultural process has shaped your chosen geographic environment.
questions.expectedAnswer: Draw annotated map/diagram explaining how a named cultural process has shaped a named geographic environment.
questions.markingGuide:
Not

WHAT YOU NEED TO INCLUDE:

For Achievement:
- Includes some relevant description of the cultural process with little or no evidence.
- Does not adequately analyse.

For Achievement:
- Includes some supporting case study evidence.
- Partially analyses how the cultural process has shaped the environment.

For Merit:
- Includes detailed supporting case study evidence.
- Analyses in detail how the operation of the cultural process has shaped the natural or cultural environment.

For Excellence:
- Insightful analysis with comprehensive, integrated case study evidence throughout.

questions.text:
How does the cultural process operate to create impacts on people in the geographic environment?

Your response to part (b) should include:
- how the operation of the cultural process has created impacts on people
- links between the elements of the cultural process to draw conclusions
- integrated comprehensive supporting case study evidence.
questions.expectedAnswer: Analyses how the cultural process impacts people in the geographic environment, drawing conclusions about links between elements.
questions.markingGuide:
Not

WHAT YOU NEED TO INCLUDE:

For Achievement:
- Describes where or how people are impacted with little analysis.

For Achievement:
- Includes supporting case study evidence.
- Describes how the cultural process operates to create impacts on people.

For Merit:
- Includes detailed supporting case study evidence.
- Analyses how the cultural process creates impacts on people, drawing conclusions.

For Excellence:
- Insightful analysis.
- Integrates comprehensive evidence throughout and analyses the links between elements to draw conclusions about how the cultural process creates impacts on people.
